verdict.rationale: Apple M5 is a system-on-chip, and operating a processor through natural-language commands is a category error for silicon. The evidence only describes the chip accelerating AI software that runs on it (Apple Intelligence, Foundation Models, LM Studio). These are host-platform or third-party capabilities, not a natural-language control interface shipped by the chip itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
